Hero.description: I am a Junior Developer and Information Systems student, passionate about technology and developing digital experiences.

About.label: About me!
About.title: Want to know more about me? Sure:
About.paragraph1: I am a Junior Developer and Information Systems student, passionate about technology and the development of digital experiences.
About.paragraph2: I have practical experience developing web and mobile applications, working with technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and React Native, as well as knowledge of back-end development.
About.paragraph3: Currently, I am deepening my knowledge of TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Next.js, and Node.js, seeking to grow technically and apply good software development practices.

technical.title: How I Work
technical.description: I strive to write clean, reusable, and maintainable code, always considering the experience of the people using the application.

current.title: Continuous Learning
current.description: I am constantly looking to grow, turn knowledge into practice, and keep up with good software development practices.

professional.title: Professional Vision
professional.description: I want to grow as a developer, contribute to meaningful projects, and help build digital products that create value.

Projects.title: Selected projects
Projects.description: A selection of projects that represent my experience, skills, and growth in technology.

project1.title: Hotel Management System
project1.description: Desktop hotel management system developed with Java, Swing, and MySQL, featuring employee, room, reservation, housekeeping, and payment management.

project2.title: Professional Portfolio
project2.description: Responsive web portfolio developed to showcase projects, experience, and professional skills, with support for multiple languages and light and dark themes.

project3.title: Task Management System
project3.description: Web application for organizing tasks and projects, featuring user authentication, activity management, and data persistence.

project4.title: Financial Management System
project4.description: Web application for personal financial management, with income and expense tracking, category management, and data visualization through dashboards.
